The '''Ailon Military Ceremonies''' was an [[Standard year/Legends|annual]] event undertaken by the [[Ailon Nova Guard/Legends|Ailon Nova Guard]]. The event was widely covered by [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] news sources and included holofeatures, fireworks, [[Laser/Legends|laser]] displays, flying displays, mock battles, feasts, parades, and festivals. One of the most prestigious events on the military calendar, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] always sent units of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and elite [[Imperial Army/Legends|army]] and [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] units to participate.<ref name="GG9" />

While allied with the Galactic Empire, the Ailon Military Ceremonies became the focus of the Nova Guards' duties. Despite being an effective military force, [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]] left the [[Ailon (species)/Legends|Ailon]] in reserve, forcing them into an enforce peace. During this time, the Nova Guard trained, upgraded its equipment and observed the Ceremonies while waiting for duty.<ref name="SW15">{{JournalCite|15|Special Military Unit Intelligence Update}}</ref>
